name: Okapi Wildlife Reserve October 2026 NDVI relative zones

metadata.cloud_mask: Sentinel-2 SCL classes 4 and 5; other classes excluded.
metadata.overlap_method: Selected one least-cloudy scene per MGRS tile; tile overlaps filled in ascending scene-cloud percentage.
metadata.grid_cell_method: 2 km square grid in EPSG:32635; geometries clipped to RFO boundary; means use valid clear-land 100 m pixels.

classification.method: Quartiles across retained 2 km cells in this October 2026 dataset; relative classes, not ecological thresholds.

metadata.emissions: Three gross emissions attributes are null (unknown, not zero); satellite vegetation indices do not measure greenhouse-gas flux.
limitations: October cloud-free coverage is incomplete and varies among cells.
NDVI/EVI are spectral vegetation-condition proxies and do not estimate biomass stock, growth, deforestation, emissions, or sequestration.
Quartile zones are relative to the retained cells in this month only; do not compare as fixed ecological classes across months.
This is not a validated disturbance, carbon-stock, or emissions map.
